column1: # uuidna cloudflare template mirror — HARVESTED from github.com/cloudflare/templates (main), each row read
# from a wrangler config in that template's own directory.
# NOTHING IS DISCARDED. Six templates ship TWO configs: their own, and a wrangler.e2e.* that deploys a
# separate end-to-end test worker (different worker name, different main, its own bindings). Both are
# recorded, distinguished by the `config` column, because dropping the e2e rows would hide a real fact
# about those templates — and because the first harvest DID drop them silently by collapsing filenames,
# which let the e2e row win for text-to-image-template and lost its Workers AI binding entirely.
# A template's coverage is computed from its PRIMARY config; the e2e rows are carried, not counted.
